summary: Satellos Bioscience filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 6, 2026 press release announcing a protocol amendment to its BASECAMP Phase 2 pediatric Duchenne muscular dystrophy trial. Following FDA feedback, the primary efficacy endpoint shifts from dynamometry to MRI-measured vastus lateralis fat fraction, with clinical endpoints as support for a potential accelerated approval pathway for forazapadin. No price, stake, or transaction terms were disclosed. Topline 12-week placebo-controlled data are expected in Q1 2027; the filing is a clinical/regulatory update, not a special situation, so the watch item is trial execution and readout timing.
